spec2def(indicdll.dll indicdll.spec)

file(GLOB indicdll_rc_deps res/*.*)
add_rc_deps(indicdll.rc ${indicdll_rc_deps})

# indicdll.dll is all Rust (indicdll-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/indicdll-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# indicdll.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/indicdll-rust/src/indicdll/indicdll.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(indicdll_res OBJECT indicdll.rc)
target_compile_definitions(indicdll_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(indicdll_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(indicdll indicdll-cargo indicdll.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE indicdll-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS indicdll_res psdk)
